summary: I wrote four M1 check scripts and one shared input file: m1_scales.py (numbers, with Pint), m1_nondim.py (symbolic, with SymPy, plus a series solution), m1_units.py (units in the notation table) and m1_validity.py (constitutive-law ranges against the stated temperature range). They cover every numeric claim in ## Mechanisms and ## Scales, and they print one JSON line per claim. All four ran and exited 0. 56 claims passed and none failed. One precision note: at τ ≈ 0.47 the error in the whole solution is 1.03 % of the peak, not quite 1 %. Because every reference parameter is 1, numbers alone cannot catch swapped parameters, so the symbolic and unit checks cover those formulas.
